text:
leah - Sales: ACME asking for a short POC (hosted + on-prem agent). They sent a SIG/CAIQ and DPA redlines. Main asks: 1) what telemetry leaves a private deployment by default, 2) can we do 14-day retention + verified deletion for POC, 3) quick hourly pricing for 2 dedicated nodes. Need answers by EOD Thu.

omar - Security: I can take the SIG mapping. Short summary: private agent does NOT exfiltrate raw prompts/responses by default; it sends a minimal heartbeat and optional aggregated counters if enabled. Will map CAIQ control IDs to our statements.

leah - Sales: They want explicit line: "Do you log prompt/response tokens during private deployment?" and "What is the DSAR deletion workflow for POC data?"

chen - Legal: We can accept a 14-day retention addendum for a time-boxed POC. Customer is controller for data in private deployments; Redwood will provide export tooling and a deletion attestation on request. I'll draft a one-page addendum and attestation template.

natalie - Eng Platform: Default private telemetry fields: {heartbeat_ts, node_id, gpu_stats, process_uptime, metrics_agg}. No prompt/response text leaves the VPC. If they enable `enable_usage_reporting: true`, we send hashed token counts only. Example config snippet to return:
```yaml
agent.telemetry:
  enable_usage_reporting: false
  heartbeat_interval_s: 60
  telemetry_retention_days: 14
```

sam - Solutions: I'll DM POC hourly for 2x A10G-equivalent nodes and a 14-day T&E. Note: committed Dedicated pricing normally needs a 1-month minimum; POC hourly is possible but billed weekly.

omar - Security: Also confirm: TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, optional customer KMS bind for private. For SIG answers I'll produce a control-ID -> statement table and upload.

leah - Sales: Action items: @omar SIG mapping, @chen 14d addendum + attestation, @natalie paste config & deletion commands, @sam price DM. I'll consolidate and reply to ACME once we have all pieces.

natalie - Eng Platform: DSAR delete flow for private: 1) redwood-admin export --subject <id> --out data.json; 2) review; 3) redwood-admin scrub --subject <id> --confirm > scrub-report.txt. We can HMAC-sig the scrub-report for attestation. Requires admin RBAC.

chen - Legal: Drafting addendum now, will upload in ~2h.

sam - Solutions: DM sent with preliminary numbers. Flagging finance approval needed for any deep discounting.

leah - Sales: Thanks team. If anything slips, ping me and I'll update ACME. Will send consolidated reply after addendum + SIG mapping + config snippet are in.
